text: Exact optimization admitted: canonical plans validate the complete frame/support graph once at the boundary, then the hot kernel uses trusted CSR row/support accessors. No value, reduction order, covariance estimator, or solve changes. On the 4,096-feature profile, evaluation fell from 28.091 s to 3.971 s (7.1x wall-time speedup), while learned-metric and crossnobis oracle suites remained green. The brain-scale gate must be rerun; the failed artifact is retained only until superseded by the rerun.
